description: M::Box.new.class.to_s -- `Object#class`, 11 sites in the slice, and the one place `Ty.clsOf` is produced by an *expression* rather than by naming a class. It is the inverse of `newInst`: `.inst n _` in, `.clsOf n` out. `purl.rb` needs it (`self.class.encode`) to reach a singleton method from an instance method.
